name: Compact
author: Freek van Gool
description: A compact layout for small screens: rotary knobs with the label underneath, knobs grouped per section in one frame, a lower XY canvas and a tighter step grid, at about half the width and a quarter of the height of the standard card.

appearances.name: Compact
appearances.description: Rotary knobs in grouped frames, about 540 px wide.
